description:
Quotes a specific booking and returns the final total and the checkout link.

The Desky interface uses it when the person changes the date or the number of seats. The total comes from the same calculation as the site's checkout, so it is the final number and not an estimate.

It does not book or charge.

dates.description: Several dates YYYY-MM-DD. Takes precedence over `date`.

starts_at.description: Start time HH:MM. Hourly bookings only.

utm_source.description: MCP client that originates the request.

name: quote_booking

is_instant.description: Whether the booking is confirmed automatically for THOSE dates. It is not the space flag: with auto-accept rules it is decided day by day.

title: Quote a booking
